text: ANTHROPIC FOUNDERS COULD RETAIN VOTING CONTROL FOR DECADES Anthropic's founders could retain 50.1% of shareholder voting power long after its IPO, even if they sell nearly all their shares. text: UBS RAISES BRENT OIL FORECAST TO $110 AS MIDDLE EAST RISKS PERSIST UBS raised its year-end Brent crude forecast to $110 per barrel from $100, citing Middle East supply disruptions, declining inventories, and record shipping costs. The bank also lifted its March 2027 target to $95 and June 2027 target to $90. text: It's officially Fed day. We expect a "hawkish pause" today. The Fed will hold interest rates unchanged but lay the groundwork for a December rate hike, bringing total rate hikes in 2026 to +50 basis points. Why? Because the US economy is now facing both supply-side and rising demand-side inflationary pressures, while the labor market continues to weaken beneath the surface. This puts the Fed in an increasingly difficult position: Inflation is demanding tighter monetary policy, while underlying labor market weakness is calling for the opposite. We expect the Fed to prioritize inflation today, keeping the door open for further tightening in December.

text: FED GOVERNOR LISA COOK SURPRISES MARKETS WITH VOTE FOR RATE HIKE Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook unexpectedly voted for a 25-basis-point rate hike, breaking with the Fed's decision to hold rates at 3.75%–4.00%. Cook joined Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack, a consistent advocate of tighter monetary policy, in the 10–2 vote. The dissent marks Cook's first vote against an interest-rate decision since joining the Fed in 2022. It also comes as President Trump makes a second attempt to remove Cook from the Fed's board, following an earlier effort blocked by the Supreme Court.
